title: High-concurrency scaling enhancements for project updates
summary: Optimizes project updates feed for 1M+ concurrent users by shifting from query invalidation to real-time optimistic cache patching, introducing localStorage-first draft sync to prevent database write churn, and adding client-side image compression before signed-url storage uploads.
concurrencyRisk: High realtime/cache coordination risk: client-side cache state can drift if real-time events are dropped, reordered, or double-applied. Mitigated by using strict event sequence counters, client-side deduplication keys, and a single cache update reducer that discards outdated payload changes.

rollback.strategy: Revert the real-time cache patching changes in UpdatesTab.tsx to fall back to query invalidation, remove the client-side WebP compression worker, and restore the 500ms debounced database draft autosaving in ProjectUpdateComposer.tsx.
